newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- EXPRESS NEWS -- The three candidates for the chief executive of the post-colonial Hong Kong Special Administrative Region said the government should not intervene in the property market.
-- HONG KONG DAILY NEWS -- The Shumshuipo district has become a "modern ghetto" with 10,000 residents living on government subsidy.
-- MING PAO DAILY -- There is an increasing number of children abandoned by single mothers and parents suffering from broken marriages waiting to be cared for by other families.
-- TA KUNG PAO -- The National Planning Conference in Beijing had decided to accelerate adjustments to China's economic structure and develop housing and electronic information products.
-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Governor Chris Patten pledged to extend a warm hand of friendship to the chief executive to be chosen on Wednesday.
-- British fund managers staged a major about-turn on Pacific basin equities with buyers outweighing sellers by 12 percent in December.
-- HONGKONG STANDARD -- Luxury residential developments are continuing to attract strong interest, with major property developers reporting booming sales.
-- China's textile manufacturers are calling for retaliatory sanctions against recently imposed anti-dumping duties by the European Union.
